༄༅/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung rab la bsngags pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung rab la bsngags pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// na maḥsarba dzñā ya gu ra we/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i yon tan mtha' klas pa// ma lus yang dag rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor can// kun mkhyen bla ma rgyal ba thams cad kyi// rgyal tshab sems dpar gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ 1 /gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings yon tan rdzogs pa'i klong*// stong chen lhums su chos nyid zad zhugs pas/ rab 'byams mkhyen pas shes bya yongs gcod pa// kun mkhyen bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa yin/ 2 /skyob pa de yi legs bshad tshig gcig gi /zur tsam thos kyang srid pa hrul po ru// nges par bgyid na bstan pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// gsung la thos bsam bgyid rnams lta ci smos/ 3 /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal sras che rnams kyis// dpa' bar 'gro sogs ting 'dzin rnam thar mthus// 'phags bzhi so skye du ma'i sprul gzugs kyis// rgyal ba'i mdzad bzang ci yang ston pa yin/ 4 /de slad kun mkhyen mchog gi sprul pa'i skus// rgyal ba'i mdzad pas snyigs ma'i 'gro skyong zhing*// thos pas grol ba theg rtse'i chos 'khong gyis// rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad/ 5 kun mkhyen bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i// legs bshad bdud rtsi shin tu dag pa 'di// lung gi chos mchog zhal nas gsung pa'i bkar// mi shes pa de ba glang ya so can/ 6 /skal ba bzang dag rab dga' skyed byos la// sangs rgyas mthong ba'i nges shes gyis shig dang*// kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad 'di mthong las// sangs rgyas mjal yang cung zad yod re kan/ 7 /thub pa'i mtshan dpe mig gi bdud rtsi ste// skal bzang yid la dad gsum bskyed pa lags// legs bshad yig gzugs bzo yi sprul sku ste// dad pa'i gsos su 'di las lhag pa med/ 8 /ston pa'i tshangs dbyangs rna ba'i bdud rtsi ste// bskal bzang yid la shes rab bskyed pa lags// legs bshad tshig phreng rna ba'i bdud rtsi ste// shes rab gsos su 'di dang mnyam pa med/

9 /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs snying gi bdud rtsi ste// bskal bzang yid la bden pa ston pa lags// legs bshad don bzang snying gi bdud rtsi ste// yid la ye shes gsos su 'di nyid che/ 10 /rnam thar ting 'dzin stobs kyis byin rlabs pas// 'di mthong yid la chos nyid shugs kyis skye// ka dag dgongs pa 'phral la ston nus shing*// chos can 'dzin pa gzhig la 'di 'dra med/ 11 /yi ge'i rnam rol shākya seng ge'i sku// rjod byed tshig phreng kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung*// brjod byed don zab rgyal ba kun gyi thugs// gsung rab 'di mthong bde gshegs yongs rdzogs mthong*/ 12 /lnga brgya tha ma'i bstan par gyur pa na// gsung rab rnam rol yi ge'i gzugs dag gis// ston pa bzhugs zhes skyob pa thugs rje can// shākya seng ge'i zhal bzhes de ltar lags/ 13 /don bzang legs bshad mdzod chen bdun la sogs// bstan pa yongs rdzogs tshe gcig sangs rgyas chos// zab lam rmad byung bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'di// kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung du su yis bsnyon/ 14 /lhun grub yon tan shin tu rgya chen po// ka dag dbyings su zab pa'i chos nyid can// zung 'jug theg rtse rdo rje snying po'i chos// rgyal kun thugs gsang 'di las ci zhig yod/ 15 /thub pa'i mdzes sku gser gyi ri 'dra ba// gzugs sku mthong ba'i khyad chos de lags mod// chos nyid rang bzhin brjod du med ston pa// chos sku mthong ba'i skal bzang 'di tsam lags/ 16 /shing dbang drung der skyob pas gang mkhyen dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyis bden pa gang gzigs pa// kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad tshig gcig gis// brjod du med don thabs kyis ston par mdzad/ 17 /yon tan rang bzhin byang chub phyogs kyi chos// ma lus yongs rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po ni// rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku'i mchod sdong ste// bsod nams zhing du 'di las lhag pa med/

18 /thub pa'i mdo sde ji snyed bsam yas pa'i// yon tan mchog kyang zab rgyas ston pas te// chos nyid rang bzhin zab cing rgya che ba// rjen par ston 'di'i yon tan yang de tsam/ 19 /de slad gzhung 'di'i tshig gcig nyan pa dang*// 'dzin klog sgrub rnams ji snyed rgyal ba'i chos// nyan dang 'dzin klog sgrub la brtson pa dang*// skal pa mnyam zhing bsod nams rnam smin mnyam/ 20 /brgyad khri bzhi stong chod don rig pa'i klong*// 'dus par nges na de yi brjod byed gzhung*// kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad zab mo'i chos// tshig bcad gcig tu ci yi phyir mi 'du/ 21 /dad pa'i sems kyi skad cig mjal na yang*// gang gi yid la gdung ba skye 'gyur pa'i// nyon mongs rnyogs pa shugs kyis 'bral bgyid pa// kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad mthong grol yin/ 22 /tshig gcig thos kyang rnam par rtog pa'i rdul// rnam par spangs nas zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin// gang gi yid la rtsol med skye 'gyur pa// kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad thos grol yin/ 23 /rtog ge'i blo gros rtsub mo'i skyon spongs pa'i// zhi ba bsil ba 'jam pa'i reg bya can// 'khor ba'i gdung sel 'chi med theg pa ste// kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad reg grol yin/ 24 /zab pa'i don bzang bdud rtsi'i ro mngar can// ji tsam myong bzhin thos bsam sgom pa'i lus// brtas pa'i 'phur ldir chos nyid dbyings spyod pa// kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad myong grol yin/ 25 /rgyal ba'i bstan pa ji snyed yongs rdzogs pa'i// gzhung bzang kun mkhyen bla mas bkral 'di 'dra// 'phags bod mkhas pa'i skye bo su yis kyang*// sngon chad 'dzam gling ljongs 'dir bzhag pa med/ 26 /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chos kyi sgo dbye na// rgyu 'bras med dbyings mnyam par la zlos pa'i// kun mkhyen bla ma'i gdams ngag 'di 'dra ba// 'chad pa'i mkhas grub gnyis pa su yang med/

27 /gzhung bzang 'di dag yan lag yongs rdzogs pa'i// lha lus mdzes pa brgyan gyis spras 'dra ste// 'di dang bskrun na mkhas pa'i bstan bcos gzhan// phyogs re'i yan lag dum bur 'thor dang 'dra/ 18 /tshig bzang snyan dngags dam pa'i rgyas gyis mdzes// don chen rgyal bstan rdzogs pa'i kho lag dar// theg rtse nor bu mchog gi thor tshugs can// gzhung bzang 'di dag lha yi dbang po 'dra/ 19 /lam stegs rgyu 'bras theg pa'i them skas bkram// gsang chen lam gyi ba gam brjid chags shing lhun grub sku bzhir bgrod pa'i rtse mo 'bar// gzhung bzang 'di dag rnam rgyal pho brang 'dra/ 30 /'dod khams dge bcu'i ri dbang lhun brjid cing*// gzugs med ting 'dzin zhi ba'i sprin tshogs bkram// gzugs khams 'phags lam rdzogs pa'i 'og min can// gzung bzang 'di dag srid pa gsum po 'dra/ 31 /gang 'dul 'gro khams mos pa de bzhin 'dul// sna tshogs shes bya'i chos kun ma 'dres 'chad// don dam mnyam pa'i klong las mi 'da' bas// gzhung bzang 'di dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dra/ 32 /ji snyed theg pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas ston// yid dpyod rgyu 'bras lam las theg dgur phye// mngon sum 'od gsal klong du spang blang zad// gzhung bzang 'di dag srid zhi gnyis ka 'dra/ 33 /don 'di shes na rdo rje snying po'i lam// snying thig gsang ba'i zab gnad snying 'dra ba'i// don 'di mi ston mkhas pa'i bstan bcos gzhan// lus nyid mdzes kyang snying med ro dang 'dra/ 34 /rtogs pa'i 'dra 'bag rdo rje snying po'i glu// mngon sum chos nyid rjen par ston pa'i ngag /klong rdol gtam 'di skad cig thos pas kyang*// 'od gsal ye shes rgyud la shugs kyis skye/ 35 /zab las ches zab chos dbyings rin po che// byin brgyud ye shes rtogs pa'i mdzod gcig pur// yang dag chos sku dngos byon gzhung 'di 'dra// gang gis nyams blang srid pa tha ma yin/

36 /zang thal rig pa kun mkhyen bla ma'i thugs// rjen par ston pa'i man ngag 'di 'dra ba// sangs rgyas dngos yin dam pa'i chos kyang yin// mos gus skyes na dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ 37 /rgyud sde kun kyi zab gnad mthar thug pa// bzhi pa'i dbang zhes grags pa 'di yin te// dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang*// gzhung bzang 'di 'dra mthong las gzhan yod min/ 38 /kun mkhyen bla ma 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i sku// sngon zhig bzhugs kyi da lta med pa min// mthong bar nus na rang gi mdun na bzhugs// rtog pas bsgrib na mngon sum byon kyang ci/ 39 /gsung gi gnad 'di rtogs pa'i 'dra 'bag ste// ye shes chen po tshig don byin gyis rlabs// mos gus can la bden tshig gtad rgya mdzad// nges par brten na bla ma 'di rang yin/ 40 /mos gus thob nas tshig don dpyod shes na// gzhung bzang 'di 'dra ci tsam mjal ba'i yun// de srid de blo chos nyid mngon sum pa'i// 'od gsal mchog las g.yo ba yod re kan/ 41 /rnam par dpyod mang ga ge'i bstan bcos gzhan// ji tsam bltas bzhin 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog 'phel// blo las 'das ston kun mkhyen bla ma'i gzhung*// tshig gcis thos kyang rtsol med ting 'dzin skyed/ 42 /rtog ge'i dkrugs pa phal ba'i gzhung mang du// 'khyams shing 'khyams pa'i don med ngal ba can// tshig don phun tshogs nor bu'i ngal stegs su// ngal bso sbyin pa kun mkhyen bla ma'i gzhung*/ 43 /phyogs re'i rig pa sbrang bu'i gshog rlabs kyis// gling bzhi nyul 'dod 'bras med ltad mo ba// rdo rje snying po'i ri rab rtser bgrod nas// theg dgu gsal ston khyung chen rgyal po 'dra/ 44 /byis pa'i bstan bcos rtsed mo'i rtsod pa can// yin dang ma yin rang rang phyogs la zhen// mnyam pa'i chos nyid rgan po'i blo gros can// kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad gzu bo yin/

45 /rmongs dang ma rig the tshom skyes pa'i dus// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// rmongs pa'i drwa ba gang gis gcod 'gyur ba'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad shes rab ral gri yin/ 46 /sna tshogs rtog pa'i bun long g.yo ba'i dus// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// 'khrul rtog rtsig pa gang gis 'jig 'gyur ba'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad ye shes rdo rje yin/ 47 /chags sdang 'khrul pa'i zug rngu 'bar ba'i dus// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// nyon mongs bud shing skad cig sreg byed pa'i// kun mkhyen legs pa'i me dpung yin/ 48 /'du 'dzi'i gnas dang skyo bas gdung ba'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// nges byung blo yis khams gso sbyin byed pa'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad bdud rtsi'i sman mchog yin/ 49 /dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur gnas pa'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// nyin mtshan 'khor yug chos kyis 'da' byed pa'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad rig pa'i skyo grogs yin/ 50 /mang po'i dbus su chags sdang ldang skyes pa'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// mnyam pa'i klong du sems dal sbyin byed pa'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad nor bu'i ngal stegs yin/ 51 /yid dpyod rtog pa'i zhe 'dod skyes pa'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// bden zhen grub mtha'i lcags sgrogs grol byed pa'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad thabs kyi lde'u mig yin/ 52 /byid rgod rmugs pas sgom gegs skyes pa'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// zhi ba'i ting 'dzin skyon med legs skyed pa'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad gnad kyi man ngag yin/ 53 /nad dang sdug bsngal gnod pa skyes pa'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*/ rkyen ngan snang ba grogs su bsgyur byed pa'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad gser 'gyur bdud rtsi yin/

54 /rig rtsal rtogs pa'i nyams myong 'bar ba'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// chos sku'i klong du mnyam nyid ngo sprod pa'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad gnad kyi bog 'don yin/ 55 /byung rgyal nyams kyi snang ba 'ur ba'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// zhen med ngang du brtul zhugs gong 'phel ba'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad rdo rje'i thol glu yin/ 56 /'dod yon longs spyod shugs kyis 'du ba'i dus// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// zhen med ngang du ci 'dod rgyan 'chang ba'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad rma bya dug rol yin/ 57 /snyems byed re dogs gzung 'dzin skyes pa'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// brtul zhugs rol pa'i dpa' gdeng skyed byed pa'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad bdud kyi gcod yul yin/ 58 /dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa a 'thas skyes pa'i tshe// gzhung bzang 'di dag blta bar byos shig dang*// bden zhen gdos bcas bun long 'jig byed pa'i// kun mkhyen legs bshad sgyu ma'i man ngag yin/ 59 /kun mkhyen legs bshad nor bu'i gter 'dra ba'i// yon tan phreng ba gzhal du mi spyod mod// cung zad smras 'dis kho bo'i spobs pa yang*// mthar thug min na brjod bya ji ltar rdzogs/ 60 /bsngags pa'i gnas 'di grangs med zhing du yang*// rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal sras mkhas rnams kyi// dam chos gtam gyi gleng gzhir gyur pa ste// so so yang dag rig pa'i spyod yul yin/ 61 /mkha' dbyings bzhin du mkhas pa'i rol gnas// so skye blo gros sbrang bu'i gshog rlabs bcas// bsngags pa'i snyan glu dar dir sgrogs pa 'di// legs bshad tshal la rab dga' skyes nas yin/ 62 /dga' bar byos shig skal bzang don mthun dag /ge sar ro mngar yang yang btung gyis la// bstod pa'i glu phreng bdag dang mthun sgrogs dang*// mi zad spobs pa khyed la mdza' bar 'gyur/

63 /bsngags 'os yul la bsngags pa'i mchod sprin 'di'i// legs byas dge ba srid la zhi rgyu dang*// zhi la srid don gnyis mthar mi gnas pa'i// rgyal dang de sras thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo/ 64 /mtshams sprin gzi 'dra mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar ba// 'jam dpal dpa' po'i mkhyen pa de dran nas// de yi rjes bzhin bden pa'i 'khor gsum blo// spongs pa'i yongs bsngo smon pa med dbyings snyogs/ 65 /bdag kyang deng nas kun mkhyen brgyud bcas kyi// smin grol rgyal thabs rgyas pa'i sgo srang nas// dad gsum slong phor gtong ba med ldan pas// blta ba'i skal bzang 'khor ba'i mtha' mar smon/ 66 /nam zhig srid dang zhi ba mnyam par brdal// 'khor ba dong sprugs zhi ba bum skur bzhengs// 'khor 'das ma lus thig le gcig gi klong*// kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs par 'dres gyur cig 67 /ces pa'ang a bu hral po'i gang dran brjod pa dge legs 'phel/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
